{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND exclude missing age (customer_age != -1)
converted_df = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding age -1): {mean_age}")"}
